## Summary

Describe what changed.

## Outcome

Describe what changes as a result, including before/after behavior when useful.

## Validation

### Pre-merge acceptance

Describe the applicable mandatory checks, results, and evidence. Identify any unperformed or environment-blocked checks accurately.

### Required post-merge verification

List only checks the actual change requires after merge and their expected results, or state "None." Keep them pending until performed. Follow the [merge and closure lifecycle](https://github.com/takahirox/visparse/blob/main/docs/development-flow.md#5-merge) for recording evidence and tracking discovered defects in linked Issues.

## Related issues

Use `Closes #N` when implementation and mandatory pre-merge acceptance are complete; pending post-merge-only verification does not prevent closure. For intentional partial work, link the parent Issue without an automatic closing reference and state the remaining scope.
